title: How Clerk 3x'd CLI signups with one error message change using Gauge (video)
summary: Clerk's Devin Gould joins Ethan Finkel to discuss the SDK error message that helped agents discover Clerk's CLI, testing the change in Gauge, and the 3x increase in CLI adoption after launch.
body_markdown:
## The conversation


Clerk's Growth Engineer Devin Gould joins Ethan Finkel to talk about a small SDK change with a measurable impact: an error message that directed coding agents away from a deprecated setup path and toward Clerk's CLI.


Devin tested the change in Gauge before shipping it. The evaluations showed agents following the new guidance and using the CLI; after launch, Clerk's own tracking showed CLI adoption tripling. We discuss how the experiment worked, why making a product easier for agents can require different choices than making it easier for humans, and how Devin brings evaluation results into code review.


Read the[Clerk case study](https://www.withgauge.com/case-studies/clerk) for more on the experiment and what the team learned.
